description: Get the tamper-evident audit trail for a transaction and verify it cryptographically against the Internet Computer root key (certificate, Merkle witness, recomputed hash chain). Each event shows who did what and when; actions taken by a bot are attributed to the signed-in human owner who authorised that bot. Returns verified=true only if the chain proves genuine canister state.

limit.description: Return only the most recent N events (default 100, max 500). Verification always covers the full chain.

name: propxchain_get_audit_trail
